name: fmp_stock_peers_bulk
description:
Peer lists for all companies at once from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), one record per symbol.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/stock-peers-bulk as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
For one company use fmp_company_peers.
